meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接向外部 API 发出 HTTPS 请求,网关自动把已保存的账号凭证注入到请求中,Claude 看不到也不接触凭证值。如果服务未连接,Claude 会把错误里的连接链接交给用户去完成授权。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取邮件、查看日历、访问 GitHub 仓库等,或要求与任何外部服务或 API 交互时触发。

say.text: 帮我读一下 Gmail 最近 5 封邮件
say.note: Claude 会直接调用 Gmail API 获取邮件

say.text: 查看一下我的 GitHub 仓库列表
say.note: Claude 会请求 GitHub API 并返回仓库信息

say.text: 查询 Stripe 最近 5 笔付款
say.note: Claude 会通过网关调用 Stripe API

howto.what_en: Claude makes direct HTTPS requests to external APIs. The gateway injects stored credentials automatically; Claude never sees them. If a service is not connected, Claude shows the user the connect URL from the error.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, etc., or interact with ANY external service or API.

say_en.text: Read my 5 latest emails from Gmail.
say_en.note: Claude will call the Gmail API directly.

say_en.text: Show me my GitHub repository list.
say_en.note: Claude will request the GitHub API and return the repos.
Claude will call the Stripe API through the gateway.
